page.layout: One printed page, one column of text from top to bottom. The top line is the running head with the page number at the left. No marginal notes. Ragged strips of the neighbouring page appear at the left and right edges and are not transcribed.

main_text.p: pag.33.lin.25. Πρόκυς᾽ χαλκηδόνος ] Nicephorus Prae-bu nominat episcopū Chalcedonensem, lib.xviii. c.xxvii. cum nos quoq; hoc loco sequemur, πρὸς τ̄ χαλκηδόνος [?].

pag.ead.lin.27. * ἐν ἡ φάσματος ] Arbitror in exem-plari, unde hęc defcripta funt fuiffe ἐν ὑν, vel tale quid, unde factum deinde quod hic vides, ἡ. Legendum autē, ἡ τ̄ σωτ[?] ἀπὸ ἐν ὕπνῳ φάσματος. Maria virgine apparuisse Chofroi per infomnium, narrat Niceph. lib. xviii. cap. xxvii.
main_text.head: Ex libro sexto.
main_text.p: pag.34.lin.22. Σιγλιδόνος ] statim posterum scribitur huius urbis nomē, at supra libro primo, Σιγλιδῶν legitur.
main_text.head: Ex libro septimo.
main_text.p: pag.36.lin.1 ἀεὶ τῷ μαυρεσίων] Punctum ponendum est ante ἀεὶ. sed aberrantem distinctionem aliquando, lector ipse poterit animadvertere.
lin.8. ἡ τῆς Αραβ. ὁ ἔθνος ] Agarenos intelligit, qui deinde etiam Saraceni dicti.

lin.9. τῆς Κόλχ] Et ea gens est barbara suspe&ta mi-bi tamen hęc vox. Nicephorus cap. xxx. Sogor natio-nis, cum suo principe Tucoch, à Chagano sublatas esse triginta myriadas. Quare si nō est falsa Nicephori lectio, Sogor ille vocat, τῆς Ἀγαρ.ἐξ pro τῆς κόλχ [?] hoc loco scribendum τύρος.

lin.10. ἐπανασ[?]ρ ἀπὸ Ρῶ] Nisi quis in his talibus historias inter se dissenter conserat, multa certe nobis ille monstra dabit. sic hīc & illos locos nemo verterit, in hoc libello, nisi cum ingenti quadam τερατολογία. Sunt enim hic que distracta sunt, ac ita porro committenda: ἀλλὰ ἢ ἐπανασ[?]ρ ἀπὸ Τυρῷ μανελῶν. vide Nicephorum lib. xviii. cap.xxx
lin.13. ἀ[?]ρ Νεκε] Idem Nicephorus eodem capite

page.notes: The Greek words in the entries are read uncertainly and are marked [?]. The bracketed Greek in lines 25, 27 and 10 of pag. 33–36 may contain printing errors. The lower-case "lector" at pag.36 is doubtful. The bottom catchword "Mucri" stands at the right below the last line. Edge fragments of the neighbouring page at the left and right are excluded.
